name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: If either Steel goes with Tesla or Tungsten goes with Laser, then Wrench does not go with Copper.
Either Diesel goes with Welder or Carbon goes with Watt.
Either Ford goes with Blowtorch, or Concrete goes with Laser — but not both.
Laser, Oscilloscope, and Wrench go with Ford, Watt, and Copper, in some order.
Diesel, Ford, and Tesla go with Carbon, Tungsten, and Blowtorch, in some order.
Ford goes with at least one of Carbon, Blowtorch, or Welder.

hints.text: Suppose Otis went with Tungsten — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Otis goes with Tungsten.
Tungsten goes with Otis, so Diesel can't go with Tungsten.
Tungsten goes with Otis, so Ford can't go with Tungsten.
Tungsten goes with Otis, so Tesla can't go with Tungsten.
…but now the clue “Diesel, Ford, and Tesla go with Carbon, Tungsten, and Blowtorch, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Otis does not go with Tungsten.
